title: Director of Operations
text:
Director of Operations – DC Restaurant Group

**DC Restaurant Group | Virginia & North Carolina**

**Salary: $150,000–$175,000 Annually**

About the Opportunity

DC Restaurant Group is seeking an experienced and results-driven **Director of Operations** to oversee daily operations across a large restaurant group with multiple locations throughout Virginia and North Carolina.

This is an exciting opportunity for a strong restaurant operations leader who is passionate about developing teams, improving restaurant performance, and driving operational excellence across multiple markets.

The Director of Operations will report directly to the Vice President of Operations and work closely with District Managers to ensure restaurants are operating efficiently, meeting company standards, and achieving financial and operational goals.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee daily operations across a large portfolio of restaurant locations, ensuring consistency and strong operational performance.
* Lead, coach, and develop District Managers to drive accountability, leadership development, and restaurant success.
* Partner with the Vice President of Operations to execute company strategies, initiatives, and operational goals.
* Monitor restaurant performance, including sales, profitability, labor costs, food costs, and overall P&L results.
* Conduct regular restaurant visits to evaluate operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and support District Managers.
* Ensure restaurants consistently meet company standards for food safety, cleanliness, customer service, and operational efficiency.
* Develop action plans to address performance challenges and improve restaurant results.
* Support recruitment, training, and development of restaurant leadership teams.
* Work closely with District Managers to improve employee retention, guest satisfaction, and overall restaurant performance.
* Provide regular updates to the Vice President of Operations regarding market performance, operational challenges, and opportunities for growth.

Qualifications

* 8+ years of progressive leadership experience in multi-unit restaurant operations.
* Previous experience as a Director of Operations, Regional Director, or senior multi-unit restaurant leader.
* Strong background in quick-service restaurants (QSR), preferably within a franchise or large multi-unit restaurant organization.
* Proven experience leading and developing District Managers across multiple restaurant locations.
* Strong understanding of restaurant financials, P&L management, budgeting, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated success improving restaurant profitability, operational standards, and team performance.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to travel regularly throughout Virginia and North Carolina to support restaurant operations.

Compensation

**$150,000–$175,000 annually**, depending on experience.

**Apply today to join DC Restaurant Group and play a key role in the continued growth and success of our restaurant organization!**

Pay: $150,000.00 - $175,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person
